sourceText: よう、爺さん。ちょっと上がらせてもらうぜ
basis: Complete original-source entry/hold/exit is present between prior and successor Rom; S25 blank -> S26 faint target -> S30 fully visible; S142 still visible -> S143/S144 fading -> S145 absent; S148 blank -> S149 Rom enters -> S153/S270 Rom held.

Across the entire target visible interval, shoulders and upper arms are covered by dark fabric with two short sleeve hems. The rounded double-rim crew neckline and plain front are stable; no jacket collar, N emblem or orange/white stripe.

The SHA-bound original model comparison image was directly viewed: the01 model has the covered shoulders and short sleeves; the02 model has bare shoulders/upper arms and a sleeveless vest. This is a model discriminator, never a replacement for the270 P29 original-source frames.

Both original variants and both currently installed descriptor/MOC/texture cores are byte matched. The variants have different MOC and texture bytes, so availability or same face/controller cannot justify treating them as aliases.

Historical formal saved P17/P18 character-only references have root-confirmed accepted packets tied to the same original resource hashes. They corroborate the resource mapping; this P29 identity is independently supported by its own full source window.
acceptedScope: visual resource identity for this one character field
